note: The requested ordered-draw formula P = 16! * product(n_i) / C(N,16) is reported exactly as specified, but it is an ordered-draw expression rather than the actual unordered-subset probability. The benchmark-valid subset probability is estimated by the Monte Carlo routine above.

structural_equivalence.abstract_definition: Canonicalize the 16-signature mapping under all bit permutations and independent bit complements; this matches _canonical_game_structure in qm9_experiment.py.
structural_equivalence.entity_labelled_definition: Canonicalize the actual source_id->signature assignment under the same bit permutations and complements; two labelled samples are equivalent only if their canonical assignments match.
